author: Zedther
body:
http://avicus.net/forums/b29d3ca17
In this thread, someone creates a vacation post, letting people
know they will be absent, yet D00ZiE says "Please refrain from making short term leaving posts"
yet everyone makes them, all the time.
TheCalined recently came back from his vacation, and he made a vacation post earlier...
What is the point of locking a post of a vacation that someone is going on?
It's not spam, and it doesn't violate any rules.
I believe that action should be taken upon D00ZiE, as this was uncalled for.
Thanks
